name: fastshare
description: Fast, private, peer-to-peer file and clipboard sharing across devices via WebRTC.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('frontend', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('dist', 'frontend', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('vercel.json', 'frontend/vercel.json');"

author: Ritik Thakur <https://www.ritikthakur.com.np>
